<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'SAR');
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
$make = function ($name, $price, $status, $sku, $description) {
  $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
  $p->set_name($name);
  if ($price !== null) $p->set_regular_price($price);
  $p->set_status($status);
  if ($sku !== '') $p->set_sku($sku);
  $p->set_description($description);
  return $p->save();
};
$ids = [];
$ids[] = $make('ساعة ذهبية ✨', '1250.50', 'publish', 'W-1', "مقاومة للماء — 50 م.\nالعلبة 38 مم.\n\nفقرة ثانية & رمز");
$ids[] = $make('Gold ring', '0', 'publish', '', '');
$ids[] = $make('مسودة', '99.99', 'draft', 'D-1', '');
$ids[] = $make('مخفي', '10', 'private', 'P-1', '');
$ids[] = $make('No price', null, 'publish', 'N-1', '');
for ($i = 1; $i <= 120; $i++) { $ids[] = $make('منتج ' . $i, (string) (100 + $i) . '.25', 'publish', 'S-' . $i, ''); }
global $wpdb;
$key = 'ck_' . str_repeat('a1', 20);
$secret = 'cs_' . str_repeat('b2', 20);
$wpdb->insert($wpdb->prefix . 'woocommerce_api_keys', ['user_id' => 1, 'description' => 'Tajribah local test', 'permissions' => 'read', 'consumer_key' => wc_api_hash($key), 'consumer_secret' => $secret, 'truncated_key' => substr($key, -7)]);
file_put_contents('/wordpress/tajribah-test.json', json_encode(['key' => $key, 'secret' => $secret, 'ids' => $ids]));
echo 'seeded ' . count($ids);
